description: Supabase migration (tour_definitions + user_tour_progress tables, RLS, 4 seed tours) and TypeScript types. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 — provides the data layer both later FEATs depend on.
steps:
Create supabase/migrations/20261022000005_onboarding_tours.sql. The file must be idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS before each CREATE POLICY, INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING). Full SQL:

-- =============================================================================
-- Onboarding Tour System Migration
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. TABLES
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.tour_definitions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  target_role public.app_role NULL,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  steps JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_tour_progress (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tour_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tour_definitions(key) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started',
  current_step INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(user_id, tour_key)
);

-- 2. RLS
ALTER TABLE public.tour_definitions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_tour_progress ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anyone can read active tour definitions" ON public.tour_definitions;
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can read active tour definitions"
  ON public.tour_definitions FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (is_active OR public.is_super_admin(auth.uid()));

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Super admin manages tour definitions" ON public.tour_definitions;
CREATE POLICY "Super admin manages tour definitions"
  ON public.tour_definitions FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_super_admin(auth.uid()))
  WITH CHECK (public.is_super_admin(auth.uid()));

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users read own tour progress" ON public.user_tour_progress;
CREATE POLICY "Users read own tour progress"
  ON public.user_tour_progress FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users insert own tour progress" ON public.user_tour_progress;
CREATE POLICY "Users insert own tour progress"
  ON public.user_tour_progress FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users update own tour progress" ON public.user_tour_progress;
CREATE POLICY "Users update own tour progress"
  ON public.user_tour_progress FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid())
  WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());

acceptance_criteria: File supabase/migrations/20261022000005_onboarding_tours.sql exists and is idempotent (re-running it does not error)
Running `SELECT key, name, is_active FROM public.tour_definitions;` after applying the migration returns exactly 4 rows: platform_welcome, docs_welcome, ops_welcome, customer_welcome
npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit exits 0 after types are added
findings: 15 pre-existing TypeScript errors in OpNotificationBell.tsx, useGamification.ts, ActivityFeed.tsx, AuditLogs.tsx, OpUserManagement.tsx — none touch tour types; tsc exits 1 due to these pre-existing issues but npm run build exits 0 (Vite builds successfully). FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 can import from 'src/integrations/supabase/types' as: Tables<'tour_definitions'>, Tables<'user_tour_progress'>. The migration file is idempotent and ready to apply via Supabase Studio SQL editor or supabase db push.
